reader.requirement: At 85 the Procedure Division may reference a Linkage Section item only if it is a USING operand of the header, subordinate to one, a REDEFINES/RENAMES of one (or subordinate to such), or a condition-name or index-name of any of those; every other reference (explicit, reference-modified, subscript, or implicit through an OCCURS DEPENDING ON object) is refused; and the USING phrases accept at least five data-names.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002 selects the 1985 wording and citation (no RETURNING, no BASED advice); the refusal itself is unconditional
edition.Cite and DialectLevel < 2002 select the message text only

ConstructRegistry procedure-returning-2002 / BASED clause: the two 2002+ legs that SealLinkageRules also admits (RETURNING item, IsBased) are refused at 85 with COBOL0900, so at 85 only the a)-e) legs can admit a record

reader.edition-search: Read SealLinkageRules, UnreferenceableLinkageRecord and the NameResolution screens; grep of DialectLevel/Cite in them; the decision (SealLinkageRules) consults no edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the decision: c2-refuse draws the same eight COBOL2746 at --std 2023; only the message and citation differ, and 2002+ adds the RETURNING and BASED legs that 85 refuses as syntax
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses cover refmod, subscript, ODO-object and USING-position references; condition-names, index-names, RENAMES, REDEFINES (legal and illegal), a 77-level item, CALL USING, EVALUATE and COMPUTE operands and the five-operand minimum are covered only by this read's probes

probes.printed: L1-A ABC REN DEF R ABCDEF / R2-B CDEF / COND OK / T(IX) 2 / SUM 006 L5 FIVE / AFTER ABCDEF 008 XYZ (exit 0)
probes.expected: accepted and run: subordinate (b), RENAMES and REDEFINES of a USING operand (c, d), a condition-name and an index-name (e), six USING operands (at least five permitted)

probes.printed: eight COBOL2746 (ISO §1985:X.5.1 GR4): N1-A (subordinate), N1-REN (RENAMES), N1-R (REDEFINES of a non-operand), N2-Q (condition-name), N3-IX (index-name), N4 (77 in COMPUTE), N1 (CALL USING), N2 (EVALUATE subject)
probes.expected: every reference refused: none satisfies a-e
refused: a reference-modified linkage item of a header with no USING phrase

probes.printed: COBOL0900 BASED clause requires COBOL-2002; COBOL0900 PROCEDURE DIVISION RETURNING requires COBOL-2002
probes.expected: refused at 85: the 2002 legs that admit a linkage record (BASED, RETURNING) do not exist in the 1985 format
outside this rule: the 1985 header format is USING {data-name-1}..., so USING BY REFERENCE in the header should be refused at 85 by the format; see notes

OK  §1985:X.5.1 GR4e  (5.1 THE PROCEDURE DIVISION HEADER)  the text is in GR4e

reader.notes: The decision is per record (SealLinkageRules) and every reference form tried at 85 is refused or admitted as GR4 a-e say; c2-refuse gives the same eight COBOL2746 at --std 2023. Lead for a DIFFERENT rule (the X.5.1 header format, not GR4): PROCEDURE DIVISION USING BY REFERENCE L1 compiles and runs at --std 85 (c2-byref), while BY VALUE is gated by pd-header-by-value-2002 and no pd-header-by-reference construct exists in ConstructRegistry.g.cs; no kb/Work note found by grep.
reader.at-2023: c2-refuse: 8 COBOL2746 at --std 2023, same references as 85

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-243/runs: r2-legal.cob (exit 0: 'COND-AB' a condition-name subordinate to an 01 REDEFINES of an operand (c,d,e), 'REN ABCDEF' a 66 RENAMES of items of that redefinition (c via d), 'T3 3' an index-name and table of a REDEFINES of the second operand (e), caller sees 'AFTER ZZCDEF 123456'); r2-refuse2.cob (three COBOL2746: a non-operand 01 referenced in a DECLARATIVES USE procedure, a WORKING-STORAGE ODO table whose object is a non-operand Linkage record (implicit, IV.4.4.1), and a contained program's own non-operand Linkage record); r2-odo-elem.cob (exit 0: an element L1-T(2) of an operand's ODO table whose object NCNT is not an operand is accepted -- the object does not contribute to that statement, consistent with the implicit-reference reading); r2-global.cob (class c: GLOBAL on a Linkage 01 refused COBOL0900 at 85, so no contained program can reach a containing program's linkage record, the 1985 X.4.6.3 SR1 arm). No form found that GR4 admits and the compiler refuses or vice versa. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:X.5.1 GR4  (5.1 THE PROCEDURE DIVISION HEADER)  the text is in GR4'; 'OK  §1985:X.5.1 GR4e  (5.1 THE PROCEDURE DIVISION HEADER)  the text is in GR4e'; 'OK  §1985:X.4.6.3 SR1  (║4.6.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR1'. The reader's USING BY REFERENCE lead concerns the header format, not GR4.
